headings.text: The Vibrus Difference -  MAXIMIZING TOTAL VALUE with:

paragraphs:
Vibrus is focused on helping our clients reach their organizational goals by helping them deliver high quality products
and services. We accomplish this by partnering with our clients in solving their staffing challenges thus allowing our clients to focus on their business.
 Vibrus has been providing compelling value to its clients since inception. The cornerstone of Vibrus’s success
has been our ability to MAXIMIZE total value for our clients.

Flexible Staffing Options: We offer a variety of placement options and can customize all programs to guarantee that the service provided actually meets
individual clients’ requirements and provides added value to your organization.

Specialized Industry
Knowledge: The Vibrus staffing team has extensive expertise in the various industry sectors we serve that is leveraged to locate and provide you with the best
staff in the industry.

Develop Strategic
Partnerships: Vibrus is committed to being a professional and value-added partner to our clients.  We endeavor to accomplish this by working closely with
our client’s staffing teams.

Credentialing and
Compliance: Vibrus maintains the strictest credentialing and compliance standards for the industries we serve and hire only those who meet, or exceed, established
standards as well as meet Vibrus’s comprehensive internal screening requirements.

Quality and Cost Effective
Solutions: Vibrus has adopted a Total Quality improvement initiative across the organization. The hallmark of this initiative is a systematic, disciplined approach
that uses industry bench marks and standardized processes to manage the business and achieve ever increasing levels of customer satisfaction. Vibrus can help optimize and
REDUCE the total cost of staff acquisition while maximizing your ROI.

24 X 7 Customer Service: Vibrus is committed to providing
superior customer service to our clients. We are available and responsive to our clients’ needs twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week. Our service guarantee ensures that you will be able to
speak to our Resource Managers and Staffing Coordinators 99% of the time. In the unlikely event that you have to leave a voice message, your call will be returned within 30
minutes. Vibrus strives to set the standard for customer service in the staffing industry.

"We deliver what we say, 24 hours a day,
7 days a week!”

Contact us today at (248) 443-5100 to
find out how we can assist you!
Web ViewMobile View

Continuity of Care Program

Team Staff Program

Managed Services Program

headings.text: You Have Come To The Right Place

paragraphs: Are you or a family member in need of one-on-one skilled nursing care?
Are you or a family member in a hospital or a facility, and have concerns about the quality of care due to the nursing shortage?
Do you know if the patient to staff ratio is available to provide optimum care?

Would you like to have the peace of mind that you or your family member has that extra attention and do not rely completely on the hospital or facility staff that is
over stretched the world.

Vibrus Group understands that no two individual’s skilled nursing needs are the same and understand the challenges of caring for
patients at home.  As a leading provider of skilled private duty nursing services our clinical and office staff
are knowledgeable in working with families, physicians and other members of the health care team to achieve the best
possible healthcare outcomes.

Vibrus is dedicated to not only providing your facility with competent and reliable staff but also exceptional customer
service.  We guarantee that anytime you call our offices, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, you will get a live customer service representative that will courteously and competently handle all your
needs. We do everything possible to minimize the stress for you and your family.
We provide skilled private duty nursing services in the following Michigan counties: Oakland, Wayne and Macomb.

Single Point of Contact: Each patient is assigned a Patient Liaison Office who would be the single point of contact for the patient or family for
the duration of service.
Complete Case Management: We work with the patient, family, physician and other members of the patient’s health care team to develop a care plan that addresses each patient’s specific needs.
24 X 7 Staffing: Our nurses and aides cover cases 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Total Scheduling Maintenance: We take total responsibility for scheduling and do not leave this work to the family.

Continuity of Care: Our services cover all cases and acuity levels, from the simplest to the most severe. We also provide non-medical home care
for seniors and others needing non-medical assistance in the home.

Respite Care: For patients whose family provides a significant portion of the care, we can provide periodic relief for family or other
caregivers.

We deliver what we say, 24 hours a day, 7
days a week!”

Contact us today at (248) 443-5100 to
find out how we can assist you!

paragraphs:
Vibrus Group's Healthcare Staffing Division is one of the leading staffing providers for medical staff to
hospitals, nursing homes and homecare companies. As a leader in the temporary

best for our staff and our facilities we work with. At Vibrus we share your passion for
Healthcare. We understand your needs, your wants, your goals and your aspirations and are committed to your success. Everything we do at Vibrus is for YOU, with YOU.

You are at the forefront of providing good patient care. We know your work is more than just
a job. It’s a conscious choice to enhance the lives of others driven by passion. You work long hours and take care of your patients’ with a smile because of your commitment to good patient

We at Vibrus share your passion for Healthcare and are committed to providing you a quality
choice in meeting your personal and professional goals. Everything we do is done with YOU in mind. If you are looking to join a company that will respect you and compensate you as a professional, you

The career options at Vibrus Group will allow you the flexibility to live your life on your
own terms, with a variety of different assignments both local and travel. Becoming a member of our team will allow you to schedule your work around your life, not the other way around.  The

supplement your income, or to work full-time and enjoy the compensation and flexibility of agency work.

We at Vibrus Group know what you’re worth.  If you have ever done work with another
agency, you may have been put in the uncomfortable position of having to “haggle” with a recruiter to get what you deserve. Simply stated, our medical staff are professionals and we treat them as
such. Our rates are among the highest you will find anywhere. We start at the top of the pay scale because that’s where YOU belong! You will also work with your own placement coordinator who will
ensure that your skills and personal schedule are matched to the right job at the right location.

The service we have received is nothing but outstanding. The customer service, attention to detail and the genuine appreciation is a breath of fresh
air in this industry. When employee issues do arise, they have always been dealt with in a positive manner leaving both parties pleased with the outcome. We are looking forward to continuing the
relationship and encourage other facilities to do the same if it is a trusting partnership that is sought.

Our facility is a long way off from most staffing agencies and due to the distance they have been unable to find us staff timely and efficiently.
Vibrus since the first day has stuck to their promises. For the first time in along while they have been able to fill our Nurse Staffing Needs with qualified and competent staff. The schedulers are
always prompt and courteous in their response times just reporting that our needs is still being worked on. They have worked very hard filling our Nurse needs even at the last minute. The staff is
always available for comments or corrective actions regarding their staff and is very involved with our In-service program. It has been a pleasure with such a reliable and dependable Staffing
Agency.

We have always been well satisfied with the service provided. They are cooperative and able to adapt to our needs at a moments notice. We have
requirements ranging from twenty-five to two hundred associates.

We have worked with Vibrus for several years now and it has been nothing but a positive experience. Vibrus and their entire staff is very
cooperative, outgoing as well as great communicators as to helping us achieve our goals. I highly recommend them and their staff to every company in need of good quality staffing
solutions.

Vibrus has been able to advance our mission by providing us qualified staff that have been competent and reliable in the care delivery to our patients.
The customer service provided by the office staff has been exceptional. The office staff has made every attempt to staff each request in a timely manner. The staff has been consistently professional,
pleasant and has diligently worked with our staff to provide the highest quality of service. Vibrus would be a tremendous asset to your company as a reliable staffing partner had had our highest
recommendation.

Because of the strength of our relationship and the quality of service you provide, your company has been chosen to be a featured partner. You possess
the skills, excellence and the loyalty our customers appreciate. We could never have made it to this point without partners like you.

It has been a pleasure to partner with you. The clinicians you have sent us are competent, compassionate professionals who have integrated well with
our team. I am pleased with the open lines of communication between organizations, speed in which issues are resolved, and your responsiveness to our staffing needs.
